title: Outpost
summary: A first-person survival mystery. Keep an arctic weather station running for five nights: the generator, battery and heater fail on their own, the weather needs logging every two hours, and the last keeper's logbook slowly reveals what happened to them.

title: Season Ticket
summary: A soccer club management game set in Valmere, a made-up northern country. Own a club in the 16-team Kestrel Football League: run the business, build the squad and change tactics mid-match. For now you can sim a full season and the playoffs.

title: Scratch
summary: A roguelike scratch-ticket engine builder. You're the night clerk at a lonely prairie gas station, owing the owner money by sunrise. Scratch tickets whose symbols interact, bolt charms onto the lotto terminal and trade for strange relics, while the night gets stranger. Fictional lottery, no real money.
